text: Binary per-row measure: from OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP), with OP title and argument as target-view context, return 1 if at least one comment directly counterargues the OP's main view or a specific OP claim, by explicitly presenting reasoning, evidence or examples against it. Quoted material counts only if the commenter uses it to argue against the OP. Return 0 if the list is valid and nonempty but no comment does so (only agreement, clarifying questions, off-topic remarks, jokes, moderator/bot notices, or tangents), and 0 for an empty valid list. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if both title and argument are missing so the view cannot be identified. Ignore OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting the outcome, even inside argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be used. Use only the current supplied text; do not infer timing or initial snapshots. Output a single 0/1 or null.
